steps.title: The Big Idea
steps.prompt: A car moves, doesn't it? But does a car ever get hungry? Does a car ever grow bigger? Does a baby car ever come out of a big car? No!

steps.title: The Big Idea
steps.prompt: So a car is not alive. Now think about you. You eat. You drink. You breathe. You grow taller every year. You are alive!

steps.title: The Big Idea
steps.prompt: And a tree is alive too — it drinks water, it grows taller, and it makes seeds that become baby trees.

stickers.meaning: Something that grows, feeds, breathes and can make babies.
Something that never grows or feeds, like a chair or a stone.
Another way of saying something that is alive, like a person, an animal or a plant.
To take air in and let air out.
The roots drink the water. The leaves make the food from sunlight.

homeActivities.text:
The house hunt — 10 minutes
Walk slowly through the house together. Point at things one by one: a chair, the cat, a plant, a mug, grandmother, the television, a fly on
the window. For each one ask the same three questions: "Does it grow? Does it need food? Can it make babies?" If the answer is yes to all
three, it is alive. Make two lists on one sheet of paper: Alive and Not Alive.
homeActivities.safety:
An adult stays with the child for every activity. No glass, no sockets, no flames, and nothing small enough to swallow is left with a child
alone. Water activities are done in a bowl or the sink, never near electrical items.
